title: Mauritius Company Profile
description: Country-specific company profile for Mauritius. The authoritative identifier is the BRN (Business Registration Number) from the CBRD/CBRIS register — but the CBRIS online search is Cloudflare Turnstile-gated and full documents are paid (planning-only). The one genuinely OPEN company dataset is a sectoral directory: data.govmu.org's 'List of ICT Companies in Mauritius' (CSV, CC-BY-SA-4.0) — name + address + district + sectors, with NO identifier (join by name). Listed companies come from the Stock Exchange of Mauritius (SEM; Official Market + DEM). Language English; currency MUR. Directors/shareholders (CBRD) are personal data (Data Protection Act 2017) — redact. The open directory carries no identifiers, status, or dates; those require the gated CBRD register.

registration.description: BRN from the CBRD/CBRIS register (Turnstile-gated, planning-only). Absent for open-directory-only companies.

brn.description: Business Registration Number (CBRD). Registry key + MRA tax basis.

legal_name.description: Company name. Open from the ICT directory (Title); authoritative from CBRD.

status.description: CBRD only (Turnstile-gated, planning-only); not in the open directory.

sectors.description: ICT sector(s) from the open directory (free-text, newline-split).

address.description: Address from the open ICT directory; or CBRD registered office.

officers.description: Directors (CBRD). PERSONAL DATA (Data Protection Act 2017) — REDACT. Planning-only (Turnstile-gated / paid).

owners.description: Shareholders (CBRD). PERSONAL DATA when natural persons — REDACT. Planning-only (paid documents).

financial_statements.description: SEM published accounts (PDF; MUR) for listed companies.
